Name: PMC-ORTHANC
//index: ADR-001: PostgreSQL index plugin, replacing the SQL Server ODBC index. The ODBC index hard-codes no ordering (OdbcIndex::HasFindSupport() returns false), which is why /tools/find with OrderBy answers HTTP 500 today.
//worklists: DB-mode worklists need the Key-Value Stores that only SQLite >= 1.12.8 and PostgreSQL >= 8.0 provide. Blocked until ADR-001 lands.
//auth: Local accounts go away with Keycloak. Until then this MUST stay empty in the repo: RegisteredUsers is cleartext.
//transcoding: IngestTranscoding affects NEW arrivals only. Changing it does not re-transcode what is already stored; that is a separate, costed decision.
